listing_copy.headline: Spacious 4‑Bedroom Home with Pool in Waterkloof Ridge
listing_copy.description: Discover this expansive four‑bedroom family residence on a 1,050 m² block in Waterkloof Ridge, Pretoria. The 280 m² home features an open‑plan lounge and dining area with a fireplace, a modern kitchen boasting granite countertops, and a master suite with en‑suite bathroom and walk‑in closet. Outdoor amenities include a swimming pool, braai area, double garage, staff quarters, alarm system, electric fencing, and a solar geyser. Pets are welcome, and the neighbourhood offers parks and several schools nearby.
